records.translation: narration：叙述者说出的内容（同时成为字幕）。action：可选的可调用对象，用于改变 UI；在光标动画完成之后、旁白播放结束之前运行。target：可选的（控件，控件内坐标）；触发操作前，光标会移动到这里。坐标相对于 `widget`。若传入 QWidget 而省略坐标，则定位其中心。`widget` 也可以是返回控件的零参数可调用对象，以支持只有前一步运行后才会出现的目标——见 Director._deref。hold_ms：步骤末尾额外静默时间，单位为毫秒；用于在下一步开始前等待 UI 变化稳定。highlight：可选控件；步骤运行期间在其周围绘制柔和高亮环。它也接受零参数可调用对象，与 `target` 相同。dim_background：当 ``highlight`` 解析成功时，使界面其他部分变暗，让高亮控件清楚地位于聚光区。若概览步骤应保持整个界面全亮，请禁用。live_capture：步骤运行时逐帧重新捕获应用。默认使用缓存截图，只有操作改变界面后才刷新。仅对确实存在动画的应用内容启用。show_pointer：为脚本点击绘制并移动小型洋红色指针。被动讲解步骤即使指定了目标或高亮控件，也应关闭它。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#96
records.source: Four candidate themes were cut on the same kind of numbers rather than shipped slow — a mesh lattice (3.2–8.1 ms), contour polylines (10.8 ms), a linked constellation and a branching mycelium (5.7–8.2 ms; see the theme list above). All four are crisp line work, and in Qt's raster engine a translucent antialiased line costs an order of magnitude more than the same pixels as a gradient — a vertical line is a thousand one-pixel spans. Painting them into the small buffer instead makes them cheap and also makes them not lines any more. The rule that fell out: *soft is cheap, crisp is expensive*, and ``drift`` is crisp only because a couple of hundred dots light 0.65 % of the page.
records.context: Four candidate themes were cut on the same kind of numbers rather than shipped slow — a mesh lattice (3.2–8.1 ms), contour polylines (10.8 ms), a linked constellation and a branching mycelium (5.7–8.2 ms; see the theme list above). All four are crisp line work, and in Qt's raster engine a translucent antialiased line costs an order of magnitude more than the same pixels as a gradient — a vertical line is a thousand one-pixel spans. Painting them into the small buffer instead makes them cheap and also makes them not lines any more. The rule that fell out: *soft is cheap, crisp is expensive*, and ``drift`` is crisp only because a couple of hundred dots light 0.65 % of the page.
records.translation: 四种候选主题依据同类实测数值被淘汰，而没有带着低性能发布——网格晶格（3.2–8.1 ms）、等高折线（10.8 ms）、相连星座和分枝菌丝（5.7–8.2 ms；见上方主题列表）。四者都是清晰线条；在 Qt 栅格引擎中，半透明抗锯齿线条的成本比相同像素构成的渐变高一个数量级——一条竖线就是一千个单像素跨度。先把它们绘制到小缓冲区会降低成本，但也使其不再是真正的线条。由此得到的规则是：*柔和效果便宜，清晰线条昂贵*；``drift`` 之所以仍清晰，只因几百个点仅点亮页面的 0.65 %。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.column_picker.SchemaReader.estimate_rows#2
records.source: **It is spelt ``_rowid_``, and that is load-bearing.** Every spaCR object table declares a column called ``rowID`` — the plate row, ``'r1'``, ``'r2'`` — and SQLite identifiers are case-insensitive, so a bare ``rowid`` resolves to *that column* rather than to the row id. The version this replaces asked for ``max(rowid)`` and got two things wrong at once on every real measurements database: it scanned the whole table to take the maximum of a text column (measured: 21 ms warm, 41 ms cold, on a 200 000-row table — precisely the ``COUNT(*)`` cost this method exists to avoid), and then ``int('r16')`` raised ``ValueError``, which is not a ``sqlite3.Error`` and so escaped the caller's handler into the Qt event loop. :mod:`spacr.predictions`, :mod:`spacr.foreign` and :mod:`spacr.data_manager` all carry a comment about this shadowing; this method had not got the memo.
records.context: **It is spelt ``_rowid_``, and that is load-bearing.** Every spaCR object table declares a column called ``rowID`` — the laboratory microplate row, ``'r1'``, ``'r2'`` — and SQLite identifiers are case-insensitive, so a bare ``rowid`` resolves to *that column* rather than to the row id. The version this replaces asked for ``max(rowid)`` and got two things wrong at once on every real measurements database: it scanned the whole table to take the maximum of a text column (measured: 21 ms warm, 41 ms cold, on a 200 000-row table — precisely the ``COUNT(*)`` cost this method exists to avoid), and then ``int('r16')`` raised ``ValueError``, which is not a ``sqlite3.Error`` and so escaped the caller's handler into the Qt event loop. :mod:`spacr.predictions`, :mod:`spacr.foreign` and :mod:`spacr.data_manager` all carry a comment about this shadowing; this method had not got the memo.
records.translation: **拼写必须是 ``_rowid_``，这一点至关重要。** 每个 spaCR 对象表都声明了名为 ``rowID`` 的列——它表示微孔板行，如 ``'r1'``、``'r2'``；而 SQLite 标识符不区分大小写，因此裸写 ``rowid`` 会解析到*该列*，而不是内部行标识符。被替换的旧版本查询 ``max(rowid)``，在每个真实测量数据库上同时犯两个错误：它扫描整张表以计算文本列的最大值（在 200 000 行表上实测：热缓存 21 ms，冷缓存 41 ms——正是本方法要避免的 ``COUNT(*)`` 成本），随后 ``int('r16')`` 抛出 ``ValueError``；该异常不是 ``sqlite3.Error``，所以会越过调用方处理器进入 Qt 事件循环。:mod:`spacr.predictions`、:mod:`spacr.foreign` 和 :mod:`spacr.data_manager` 都有关于此遮蔽问题的注释，本方法此前没有同步这一约定。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#1
records.source: spaCR runs concentration series and has, until this module, had no curve fitter at all: a screener with eight doses and three replicates exports a CSV and opens Prism. The point of writing one is not that "it fits" — every optimiser fits — but that **the answer is often "you cannot tell from this experiment", and no fitter in common use says so.** ``curve_fit`` will return four numbers and a covariance matrix for a dilution series that never reached a plateau, for a bell-shaped cytotoxicity curve, and for eight points of pure noise. All three come back looking like an EC50 with a confidence interval.

The point of writing one is not that "it fits" — every optimiser fits — but that **the answer is often "you cannot tell from this experiment", and no fitter in common use says so.** ``curve_fit`` will return four numbers and a covariance matrix for a dilution series that never reached a plateau, for a bell-shaped cytotoxicity curve, and for eight points of pure noise. All three come back looking like an EC50 with a confidence interval.
records.translation: spaCR 会运行浓度系列，但在本模块之前完全没有曲线拟合器：使用八个剂量和三个重复的筛选人员只能导出 CSV，再打开 Prism。编写拟合器的重点并非 "it fits"——任何优化器都能拟合——而是**答案经常是“本实验无法判断”，常用拟合器却都不会这样说明。** ``curve_fit`` 对于从未达到平台期的稀释系列、钟形细胞毒性曲线，甚至八个纯噪声点，都会返回四个数和一个协方差矩阵。三种情况看起来都会像一个带置信区间的 EC50。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.figure_queue#5
records.source: **RAM cap + temp spill** — the 100 most-recent figures keep their full-resolution QPixmap in RAM. When figure #101 arrives, figure #1's pixmap is dropped from RAM (its PNG stays on disk in a temp dir); #102 evicts #2, and so on — a 100-wide sliding window. Navigating back to an evicted figure reloads it from its temp PNG on demand.

When figure #101 arrives, figure #1's pixmap is dropped from RAM (its PNG stays on disk in a temp dir); #102 evicts #2, and so on — a 100-wide sliding window. Navigating back to an evicted figure reloads it from its temp PNG on demand.
records.translation: **RAM 上限加临时文件溢出**——最近的 100 个图形把全分辨率 QPixmap 保存在 RAM 中。图形 #101 到来时，会从 RAM 删除图形 #1 的像素图（其 PNG 仍保存在临时目录）；#102 淘汰 #2，依此类推，形成宽度为 100 的滑动窗口。返回已淘汰图形时，会按需从临时 PNG 重新加载。

An object with no measurement is not an object inside the region, and letting it through would put objects with no value into a population the user defined by value; the same rule :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` applies to NaN.

An object with no measurement is not inside the region. Letting it through would put objects with no value into a population the user defined by value; the same rule :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` applies to NaN.
records.translation: 点是否位于多边形内采用向量化的奇偶射线法。x 或 y 缺失的行位于**所有数据选择边界之外**。其状态不是 "unknown"，也不会被静默保留。没有测量值的对象不在区域内部；若让它通过，就会把无值对象加入用户按数值定义的群体。:class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` 对 NaN 采用相同规则。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#16
records.source: :data:`NAN_AUTO`, the default, picks between the first two by how the missingness is shaped, because in this table the two shapes are far apart: a structural NaN affects tens of percent of the rows (every uninfected cell), a sporadic one affects a handful (one object where mahotas returned nothing). So a feature missing in more than :data:`DEFAULT_STRUCTURAL_MISSING` of the rows is treated as structural and dropped by name; rows still carrying a NaN among the survivors are dropped as sporadic and counted. Nothing is imputed, and both actions appear in :attr:`PCAResult.notes` and in :meth:`PCAResult.report`.

records.translation: 默认值 :data:`NAN_AUTO` 会依据缺失值的分布形态在前两种策略中选择，因为本表中的两类形态差异很大：结构性 NaN 影响数十个百分点的行（每个未感染细胞），偶发缺失只影响少量行（例如某个对象上 mahotas 未返回结果）。因此，某特征若在超过 :data:`DEFAULT_STRUCTURAL_MISSING` 比例的行中缺失，就按结构性缺失处理并按名称删除；剩余特征中仍含 NaN 的行按偶发缺失删除并计数。不会进行插补，两类操作都会记录在 :attr:`PCAResult.notes` 和 :meth:`PCAResult.report` 中。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.power_design#13
records.source: 1. **A replicate whose fit failed or did not converge counts as a non-detection**, not as a missing value. Dropping it would raise the reported power by removing exactly the runs where the design was too thin to fit — which is the failure mode the analysis is supposed to find. 2. **The mean AUROC is reported beside the power**, over the replicates that did converge, with the count of those that did not. A power of 0/5 with five non-converged fits and a power of 0/5 with five converged fits at AUROC 0.52 are different findings.
records.context: 1. **Count failed or non-converged fits as non-detections.** Do not drop them: that would inflate statistical power by removing executions whose design was too weak to fit. 2. **Report mean AUROC beside statistical power.** Calculate the mean over converged fits and also report how many fits failed or did not converge. Thus power 0/5 with five non-converged fits differs from power 0/5 with five converged fits at AUROC 0.52.
records.translation: 1. **把拟合失败或未收敛的重复计作未检出。** 不要删除它们：那会移除因设计太弱而无法拟合的运行，从而夸大统计功效。2. **在统计功效旁报告平均 AUROC。** 对已收敛拟合计算均值，同时报告失败或未收敛的拟合数量。因此，五次均未收敛而功效为 0/5，与五次均收敛、AUROC 为 0.52 而功效为 0/5，代表不同结论。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#2
records.source: **Per-frame masks are cached** under a *segmentation signature* — the source path, the frame indices, and every setting that can change a label image (model, channel, diameter, flow threshold, cell probability, normalisation). Change a *tracking* setting and the signature is unchanged, the cache hits, and only :func:`link_tracks` runs. Change a segmentation setting and the signature moves, so the masks are rebuilt.
records.context: **Per-frame masks are cached** under a *segmentation signature* — the source path, the frame indices, and every setting that can change a label image (model, image data channel, diameter, flow threshold, cell probability, normalisation). Change a *tracking* setting and the signature is unchanged, the cache hits, and only :func:`link_tracks` runs. Change a segmentation setting and the signature moves, so the masks are rebuilt.
records.translation: **逐帧掩模会缓存**在一个*分割签名*下——签名包含源路径、帧索引以及所有可能改变标签图像的设置（模型、图像数据通道、直径、流阈值、细胞概率、归一化）。更改*跟踪*设置不会改变签名，因此可命中缓存，只运行 :func:`link_tracks`。更改分割设置会改变签名，所以会重新构建掩模。

Send the HTML when you can.

records.label: spacr.resume.completed_fields_in_db#2
records.source: "Present" means present in a row **measure wrote**. Rows a foreign import copied into a canonical table do not count: a project built purely by import has ``cell`` as its only field table and a row in it for every field, so counting them made this function report the whole plate measured, ``measure_crop`` run nothing at all, and the collaborator's numbers stand as spaCR's output. A table holding nothing but imported rows is left out of the "every table this run writes" set entirely, so it cannot make every field look partial either; it rejoins the moment measure puts a row in it. See :func:`measure_rows_clause`.
records.context: "Present" means present in a row **measure wrote**. Rows a foreign import copied into a canonical table do not count: a project built purely by import has ``cell`` as its only microscope field of view table and a row in it for every microscope field of view, so counting them made this function report the whole laboratory microplate measured, ``measure_crop`` run nothing at all, and the collaborator's numbers stand as spaCR's output. A table holding nothing but imported rows is left out of the "every table this processing session writes" set entirely, so it cannot make every microscope field of view look partial either; it rejoins the moment measure puts a row in it. See :func:`measure_rows_clause`.
records.translation: "Present" 表示存在于**由 measure 写入**的行中。外部导入复制到规范表的行不计入：纯导入项目只有 ``cell`` 这一张显微镜视野表，而且每个视野都有一行；若统计这些行，函数会报告整块微孔板已测量，``measure_crop`` 完全不运行，而协作者的数据会被当作 spaCR 输出。仅包含导入行的表会从“本处理会话写入的每张表”集合中完全排除，因此也不会让每个视野看起来都是部分完成；measure 一旦向其中写入一行，该表就会重新加入。见 :func:`measure_rows_clause`。

records.label: spacr.resume.plan_measure_resume#3
records.source: 1. Read the previous run's settings out of the ``settings`` table in ``measurements.db`` and refuse loudly if anything material differs. **This must happen before** ``spacr.io._save_settings_to_db`` overwrites that table with the current settings — hence the placement of the call in ``measure_crop``. 2. Enumerate the fields in ``merged/`` and *validate* each one: a truncated ``.npy`` from a crash mid-``np.save`` is pending, not done, and is counted as rejected. 3. Ask the database which fields already have rows in **every** table the run writes. Fields with rows in only some tables are partial — a process killed between two inserts — and are re-queued. 4. Delete every row belonging to a pending field before it is re-run. This is what stops the resume from doubling rows. 5. Print the plan.

records.translation: 1. 从 ``settings`` 表读取上一个处理会话的设置；该表位于 ``measurements.db`` 中，只要任何实质内容不同就明确拒绝。**这必须发生在** ``spacr.io._save_settings_to_db`` 用当前设置覆盖该表之前——因此调用放在 ``measure_crop`` 中。2. 枚举 ``merged/`` 中的视野并逐一*验证*：崩溃中途留下的截断 ``.npy`` 属于待处理而非完成；这种文件来自未完成的 ``np.save``，并计为被拒绝。3. 查询数据库，确定哪些视野已在处理会话写入的**每张**表中都有行。只在部分表中有行的视野属于部分完成——进程可能在两次插入之间被杀死——应重新排队。4. 在再次执行待处理视野前，删除属于它的每一行，从而防止恢复操作产生重复行。5. 打印计划。

records.label: spacr.runctx#3
records.source: **One seed that reaches everything.** ``random_seed`` used to be read by :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` and :mod:`spacr.sim` and nowhere else, so a "reproducible" run still shuffled its fields differently, split its folds differently and initialised Cellpose differently every time. :func:`seed_everything` seeds Python, NumPy (legacy global *and* the :class:`~numpy.random.Generator` stream :func:`spacr_rng` hands out), Torch on CPU and every CUDA device, and — through those two — Cellpose. sklearn has no global seed at all; :func:`random_state` is what estimator construction sites pass. What cannot be made deterministic is listed in :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` and in :func:`seed_everything`'s docstring rather than papered over.
records.context: **One seed that reaches everything.** ``random_seed`` used to be read by :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` and :mod:`spacr.sim` and nowhere else, so a "reproducible" run still shuffled its fields differently, split its folds differently and initialised Cellpose differently every time. :func:`seed_everything` seeds Python, NumPy (legacy global *and* the :class:`~numpy.random.Generator` stream :func:`spacr_rng` hands out), Torch on CPU and every CUDA device, and — through those two — Cellpose. sklearn has no global seed at all; :func:`random_state` is what estimator construction sites pass. What cannot be made deterministic is listed in :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` and in :func:`seed_everything`'s docstring rather than papered over.
records.translation: **一个随机种子覆盖所有组件。** ``random_seed`` 过去只由 :mod:`spacr.deep_spacr` 和 :mod:`spacr.sim` 读取，因此所谓 "reproducible" 运行仍会在每次执行时以不同方式打乱视野、拆分折叠并初始化 Cellpose。:func:`seed_everything` 会设置 Python、NumPy（旧式全局状态*以及* :class:`~numpy.random.Generator` 流，该流由 :func:`spacr_rng` 提供）、CPU 上的 Torch 和每个 CUDA 设备；通过后两者也会设置 Cellpose。sklearn 根本没有全局种子；构建估计器时由各调用位置传入 :func:`random_state`。无法实现确定性的部分会列在 :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` 和 :func:`seed_everything` 的文档字符串中，而不是被掩盖。

records.label: spacr.seg_qc#2
records.source: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — a channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone; nobody looks, because looking means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files by hand.
records.context: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every image data channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — an image data channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone; nobody looks, because looking means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files by hand.
records.translation: ``measure_crop`` 是 spaCR 中成本最高的步骤：它打开每个掩模，从每个图像数据通道中切出每个对象，为每个对象计算数百项特征，并写入 SQLite。对完整微孔板，这需要数小时。若分割已经崩坏——图像数据通道失焦、直径偏差两倍、汇合单层融合成大片——仍会消耗同样的数小时，最终却只能丢弃测量表。仅查看掩模就能明显发现失败；但没人会检查，因为那意味着手工打开一千个 ``.npy`` 文件。
